entries.heading: PURPOSE AND TREATMENT OF CERTAIN AUTHORIZATIONS OF APPROPRIATIONS
ancestors: TITLE XV—AUTHORIZATION OF ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATIONS FOR OVERSEAS CONTINGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
SEC. 1501. PURPOSE AND TREATMENT OF CERTAIN AUTHORIZATIONS OF 
                          APPROPRIATIONS.

    The purpose of this subtitle is to authorize appropriations for the 
Department of Defense for fiscal year 2018 to provide additional funds 
for overseas contingency operations being carried out by the Armed 
Forces.
